purpose: Every tracked file must resolve to exactly one integrity role and one check scope. tools/repo-check.py FAILS on any unclassified path; a new directory never silently inherits informational treatment.

integrity_roles.frozen: Imported bytes. Must match docs/provenance/REPO-IMPORT-MANIFEST.json exactly, unless the exact path appears as an authorized override in docs/provenance/CANDIDATE-CHANGES.json. Drift, deletion and reclassification all fail.
integrity_roles.maintained: This repository's own work. May change freely, but must still pass the checks its scope requires.

check_scopes.authored-source: Current authored application, tool, UI and test source. Syntax/parse failures FAIL the run.
check_scopes.retained-evidence: Recovered, decompiled, generated or probe evidence. Parse failures are findings to triage, never repaired by editing imported bytes. Each known defect must be registered by exact path and hash in CANDIDATE-CHANGES.json; an unregistered defect FAILS.
check_scopes.maintained-candidate: New candidate source and tests authored in this repository. Receives the strictest treatment: syntax, targeted lint where configured, and functional tests must pass.
check_scopes.documentation: Markdown and text. Relative links must resolve.
check_scopes.repo-tooling: This repository's checkers and their tests. Syntax and self-tests must pass.
check_scopes.repo-config: Workflow, template, ignore and container configuration. YAML/JSON must parse.
check_scopes.provenance-record: Frozen or generated provenance records. JSON must parse; frozen copies must match their recorded hash.

precedence: Longest matching prefix wins. An exact-path rule beats any prefix rule. NOTE: a nested evidence/ directory must have its own rule — longest-prefix matching would otherwise send it to the enclosing source rule and give generated fixtures authored-source treatment. The no-evidence-as-authored-source check enforces this.
